title: Understudying Sidney Bechet in "Hear That Music"
summary: Budd is hired on 48th Street as Bechet's understudy for a short-lived play that opens and closes within a week.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: It was called 'Hear that Music.' And Bobby Sherwood was the lead. Sidney was the next to the lead in the play. And I happened to be walking down 48th Street one day, and I walked by, and the guy come out and he says, hey! Can you act? And I said, well, I don't know. I think I could act. So he said, Well, step inside. He says, step inside. He says, you want to sign up for this play? We need an understudy for Sidney Bechet.
I says, Sidney Bechet? I said, I know Sidney Bechet. I said, yeah. So they gave me the script and

everything and put me in Equity and I signed up, and I was his understudy for this play. Well, unfortunately it didn't last. I mean we rehearsed in New York, and we went up to the (E ) Theater up in Buffalo, New York, and opened, and we came back to New York, and it opened and closed in a week. But it was a pretty good play.
